lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay. Camera's rolling. Just talk to me, not the lens.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I've been thinking about this moment for weeks, and now... my mind is blank.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then don't think. Tell me why you're really here. Why Dubai?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Because I want a future I can't yet see. I mean... a future I have to build myself.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That. Right there. Say that again — like it matters.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَالنَّهَارْدَه مَعَاكُمْ فِي "يَلَّا فْلُوَنت"... مَشْهَدْ حِمِيمْ جِدًّا: مَكَّال بِيْسَجِّلْ فِيدْيُو "رايزِينْج ڤويسِز"... وَبِيْحِسْ إِنِّ دِمَاغُه فَضِي!
lines.direction: warm welcome, bright energy, quick hook

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بُصُّوا... النَّهَارْدَه هِنِتْعَلِّمْ تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَاتْ بِسِيطَة... وَمُهِمَّة جِدًّا: إِزَّايْ تِقُولْ رَأْيَكْ، وَإِزَّايْ تِحْكِي حِكَايَة، وَإِزَّايْ تِتَكَلِّمْ عَنِ الْمُسْتَقْبَلْ.
lines.direction: clear, teaching tone, counting on fingers

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ تَلَاتَة جُمَلْ: I want a future I can't yet see... وَلَا حِظْ كَلِمَة yet يَا جَمَاعَة، مَعْنَاهَا "لِسَّه"، زَيِّ مَا تِقُولْ أَنَا لِسَّه مَا وَصِلْتْ.
lines.direction: playful emphasis on the English phrase, slowing down for 'yet'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبَعْدِينْ: I want to build my future myself... وَكَلِمَة أَخِيرَة: That's what I'm working for، وَلْزَمْ تِسْمَعُوا إِزَّايْ مَكَّال هِيْقُولْهَا مِنْ قَلْبُه! يَلَّا... نِسْمَعْ.
lines.direction: rising excitement, hand-off to the scene

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You froze again. That's the third take. What's going on in there?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I keep thinking about Tarek. His video looked perfect. And I'm not sure mine will ever be good enough.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Forget Tarek. This isn't a competition about cameras. It's about you. So tell me — what do you actually want?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? I want a future I can't yet see. But I've decided I'm going to build it myself, no matter how long it takes.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That's it. See how you just spoke? No script, no tricks. That's the voice they're looking for.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: You really think so? Because some days I feel like I'm still learning to speak at all.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Everyone feels that. But you've grown so much since you got here. Don't you see it?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Maybe. I live here since two years, and only now I'm starting to sound like myself.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, that sentence — we'll fix that later. Right now, keep going. Tell me about Egypt. Why did you leave?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Because staying felt safe, and safe wasn't enough. My family thinks I already made it. I can't tell them I'm still fighting.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then say that. Say the real thing. When you speak your truth, people listen — and I'm one of them.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. No more hiding. This is what I'm working for — and this time, I mean every word.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا جَمَاعَة، نِفَكِّكْ الْمَشْهَدْ مَعَ بَعْض... أَوَّلْ تَعْبِيرْ: I want a future I can't yet see، يَعْنِي عَايِزْ مُسْتَقْبَلْ لِسَّه مَا شُفْتُهْ، وِالـ yet دِي مَعْنَاهَا "لِسَّه"، زَيِّ مَا تِقُولْ: I haven't finished yet.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: التَّعْبِيرْ التَّانِي: That's what I'm working for، يَعْنِي "دَا اللِّي أَنَا بِشْتَغِلْ عَشَانُه"... وِتِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا تِحِبْ تِقُولْ إِنِّ فِيهْ حَاجَة تَعْبَانْ عَلِيهَا، زَيِّ: My family is what I'm working for.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّالْتْ: I'm still learning to speak at all، يَعْنِي "لِسَّه بِتْعَلِّمْ أَتْكَلِّمْ أَصْلًا"... وِالـ still دِي كَلِمَة جَمِيلَة جِدًّا، بِتَقُولْ لِلسَّامِعْ إِنِّ الْحِكَايَة لِسَّه مِكَمِّلَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دَلْوَقْتِي، غَلْطَة مَكَّال: قَالْ I live here since two years... الْغَلْطَة دِي بِنْعَمِلْهَا كُلِّنَا، لِأَنِّ فِي الْعَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ "أَنَا عَايِشْ هِنَا مِنْ سَنِتَيْنْ"، فَبِنْنَقِلْهَا زَيِّ مَا هِيَّ... لَكِنْ فِي الْإِنْجِلِيزِي، لَمَّا الْحَاجَة بَدْأَتْ فِي الْمَاضِي وَمِكَمِّلَة، بِنِسْتَخْدِمْ I have lived here for two years، أَوْ I've been living here for two years.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خُدْ بَالَكْ... فِي الْإِنْجِلِيزِي بِنِسْتَخْدِمْ for مَعَ الْمُدَّةْ، وَ since مَعَ نُقْطَة الْبِدَايَة، زَيِّ: since 2022، أَوْ since I arrived.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وِالْأَهَمْ يَا جَمَاعَة... لَمَّا تِتَكَلِّمْ مِنْ قَلْبَكْ زَيِّ مَا مَكَّال عَمِلْ، النَّاسْ بِتِسْمَعْ! إِحْنَا كُلِّنَا بِنْغَلَطْ، وَالْغَلْطَة دِي مُشْ عَيْبْ... دِي خُطْوَة. يَلَّا، نِكَمِّلْ.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay. Camera's rolling. Just talk to me, not to it.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Right. So... my name is Macal, and I've been living here for two years now.
lines.direction: nervous at first, then settling in

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Back in Egypt, everything was safe. But I want a future I can't yet see — so I'm building it, one word at a time.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I'm still learning to speak at all. But that's okay. Being imperfect here beats being invisible back home.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Keep going... that's it. That's the real you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My family is what I'm working for. Some nights I call them and I say nothing. I just listen.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Sorry — your flat white. You two sounded so good, I forgot to bring it earlier.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: See? You just made someone stop and listen. That's the whole point.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? I felt it. For the first time, I wasn't translating. I was just... talking.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: So we send it tonight. Deal? We'll polish it later — I mean, after I check mine.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hold on, one second. Sorry — this is from Chicago.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: They're offering me a role. In Chicago. Next month.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...That's amazing, Nour. Really.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I don't know. Let's... talk about it after. We still have your video.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا جَمَاعَة... نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَة: عِنْدِنَا I've been living here for two years، وَعِنْدِنَا for مَعَ الْمُدَّةْ، وَ since مَعَ نُقْطَة الْبِدَايَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة دِي، خُدْهَا مَعَاكْ: I'm still learning... but I'm building my future، one word at a time.
lines.direction: slow, proud emphasis on the English

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وِالْمَرَّة دِي مَكَّال تَكَلَّمْ مِنْ قَلْبُهْ... وَإِنْتَ كَمَانْ تِقْدَرْ! اكْتُبْ لِي عَ التِّلِجْرَامْ: إِيهْ الْجُمْلَة الِّي حَاسِسْ إِنَّهَا بَيْنَتَكْ وِبَيْنَ حُلْمَكْ؟

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَتْنَسَاش تِعْمِلْ سَابْسْكْرَايْبْ، عَشَانْ الْحَلْقَة الْجَايَة... نُور عَنْدَهَا خَبَرْ كَبِيرْ، وَمَكَّال هَيِقُولْ كَلِمَة صَعْبَة جِدًّا.
